findings: Forge patched ServerPlayer.restoreFrom copies only PERSISTED_NBT_TAG before onPlayerClone(this,old,!keepEverything); it initially passes the same Tag reference. ContentProgress/SecretTracker deep-copy the nested compound. This reviewed path is not a whole-root clone.

DynastyStats permanent merit/rank/loyalty/rebellion live at root. Full DynastyStats contains no Clone handler; project Clone search found no generic root copier. RankPerks.apply recomputes rank from merit, so lost merit affects permanent attributes. This is source-level cause support, not new native reproduction.

DynastyBossCombat writes firstkill receipt to both root and Persisted before reward delivery; if either exists it sets only Persisted and returns. Persisted prevents this method replaying firstkill rewards after clone but does not rehydrate root-only consumers.

EquipmentBehaviors.revengeBonus reads root firstkill/gift/bossKinds/list. ArmyEncounters stage>0 checks root firstkill OR army_clear advancement OR creative. Persisted-only receipt may therefore differ from combat bonus eligibility, and from army eligibility only when its other alternatives fail.

DynastyWeaponGifts uses root dynasty_gift_ flags plus root bossKinds/list. Grant sets root flag before registry lookup and inventory/drop. Clone preservation must keep these complete receipts and aggregate/list coherently; do not infer receipt from mere inventory possession and do not replay grant/tick/onMobKill to migrate.

ContentProgress crown grant/openedTrinkets use EquipmentBehaviors.saved and copy Persisted. Reconcile advances from base item IDs/recipe events, not NBT-qualified paid variant receipts. Existing task integration must not treat those generic acquisitions as proof of a particular variant.

School progression has explicit deep copy dynastySchoolProgression; slot milestones copy Persisted/dynasty_slot_milestones; ArmyRoster deep copies DynastyArmyV1. Preserve their ownership instead of introducing a second conflicting copy/reset or invoking rewards.

SecretTracker deliberately copies Persisted and discrete cod3_progress_8/30, while continuous challenges reset. ExpansionSupplies clone explicitly clears guide and warmth. A whole-root wildcard clone would resurrect temporary challenge/guide/control states and is rejected.
Prior world-store audit remains separate: Bounty overworld UUID store and Dungeon dimension escrow must not enter player Clone whitelist and must not run reward APIs as migration.

Future bounded implementation requires explicit stable root key allowlist and same-player ownership, deep copies, idempotent no-reward synchronization, death/nondeath semantics, and original-versus-new object independence. No current implementation, negative-NBT execution, real TCP, two-player or current-pack acceptance in this receipt.
